rows.grounds: sarasvatyā (instrumental, 'with Sarasvatī') + samopetam (endowed with), describing the object of worship
lokapāla-ādi (world-guardians and others) + saṃyutam (joined with), describing the object of worship

items.question: What additional divine companions accompany Rudra in the eastern worship?
premises: Rudra is worshipped in the eastern direction.
Rudra is accompanied by the goddess Gaurī.
Rudra is further endowed with Sarasvatī and joined with the world-guardians and others.
items.inference: The eastern worship of Rudra includes Sarasvatī and the world-guardians among his accompanying retinue.
items.plain_english: Worship Rudra endowed with Sarasvatī and accompanied by the world-guardians and others.
